name: Becoming More Like Christ
overview: Scripture teaches that becoming more like Christ involves a deliberate process of transformation where believers decrease so Christ may increase within them, as expressed in John 3:30. This transformation is rooted in God's predestined plan for believers to be conformed to the image of His Son (Romans 8:29). It requires presenting ourselves as living sacrifices, holy and acceptable to God, and renewing our minds to discern His perfect will (Romans 12:1-2). Living by faith in Christ, who lives in us, empowers this spiritual growth, as we recognize that we are God's workmanship, created for good works prepared in advance for us to walk in (Galatians 2:20; Ephesians 2:10).
